headline: Citi gives up on big tech trade
detail: This signals a potential shift in sentiment for large tech companies. Given your concentration, this could put further pressure on your tech and chip holdings.
rec: Consider trimming positions in SMCI and MU if this sentiment continues to impact their prices.

headline: Tech stocks forecast for another bounce
detail: Deutsche Bank sees potential for a V-shaped rebound in tech, similar to past instances. This offers a glimmer of hope for your heavily concentrated tech portfolio.
rec: Monitor your holdings for signs of this predicted bounce, but remain cautious given the leveraged nature of some positions.

headline: U.S. crude falls below $100
detail: Falling oil prices could indicate easing inflation concerns or geopolitical de-escalation. This might indirectly benefit some tech components if it leads to a broader market rally.
rec: This headline has minimal direct impact on your tech-heavy portfolio, so no specific action is warranted.
